DECL	{"assumptions":[],"binders":["subject"],"id":"NRS_484B_633_2","intentions":[],"laws":["NRS-484B-633-2"],"narrowings":[],"operationalizations":[],"residues":["The authority's investigation, on request or on its own initiative, of structures built under chapter 408 of NRS (outside the corpus) is the process behind the posting; the rule reads the posted sign as the evidence of it.","The authority's finding that the structure cannot withstand the otherwise permissible speeds (chapters 484A to 484E, no node of the corpus) is the reason for the posting; the rule reads the posted maximum, not the finding.","The authority's determination and declaration of the maximum speed is read through the value the posted sign states; the act of declaring is not observable.","The sign's placement before each end of the structure is the authority's duty; the rule reads the sign's governance of the structure's travel regions, not its distance from the ends, so the placement is not checked."],"surrogate":false}
